# RPC grid: every cell and framed twin, one run

CONTAINER INSTRUMENTATION, not a result (README 1.1), not gated (every call checked, the client's pre-checks on). One `gen/opt_bench.sh` run, ONE server process (poc/rust's tonic `rpc_server` through `serve.sh`, pinned to AK_CPU_SERVER) for the whole grid. Per call: client process CPU (or wall) of one Google Benchmark repetition divided by its calls, in **microseconds**; each entry is the median over the repetitions with [min-max]. `k` = calls in flight (c and d run at 1 and 8 only). `pinned` and `shipped` are the two transport configurations; the full client (cells in drop and retain) and the no-unknown client (`-nounk` cells, and its own A and B) are separate processes. `f` = the core's framed send path (labelled extra cells), placed under its reference twin. `†` = at least one repetition was a single batch (one Google Benchmark iteration: the batch took longer than min_time), so that sample is one batch of k calls. Source: `summary-rpc.tsv` (ns).

Repetitions per entry: 3.

    # commit 67ae45c48bfd; Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.80GHz, 4 CPUs; client CPUs 1, server CPUs 2,3; g++ (Ubuntu 13.3.0-6ubuntu2~24.04.1) 13.3.0; protobuf 3.21.12, grpc++ 1.51.1; rustc 1.94.1 (e408947bf 2026-03-25)
    # settings   launch=1; codec P (--only P): rounds=5 min_time_s=0.01 warmup_s=0.005; codec U (--only U-, the 92 rows): rounds=3 min_time_s=0.003 warmup_s=0.001; pool_bytes=1048576 (walked since H-1; not beyond this container's 33 MiB L3); rpc: rounds=3 min_time_s=0.04 warmup_s=0.02 inflight=1,8,16 transports=shipped pinned, server warm-up serve.sh warm 50, server tokio workers 4 (serve.sh default); order: codec full-P, nounk-P, full-U, nounk-U; rpc one server, per transport full then nounk client; Google Benchmark random interleaving within each process
    # CONTAINER INSTRUMENTATION, not gated (gen/opt_bench.sh; the correctness gate is not run in the optimisation phase); the codec process's own pre-check and the RPC client's own checks are on
